main_measure.name: pooled excess 24-bar forward return in zone (forecast > 0) over the window's all-block mean

statistic.name: t of the mean of pooled per-block excess

main_measure.threshold: confirm: excess > 0 with t >= 2 and >= 4 of 6 windows positive; reject: excess < 0 with t <= -2; at least 150 in-zone blocks

supporting_check.name: share of positive in-zone blocks minus share over all blocks (>= 0)

decided_by: Inconclusive: t lies strictly between -2 and +2 (or sign and t disagree).
reading: Blocks start at positions 0, 24, 48, ... of each window and are in-zone when forecast > 0 at the block start; each in-zone return is reduced by the mean of all blocks of its window, and the pooled excesses are tested with the ordinary t of the mean; a window counts as positive if its mean excess is > 0; the supporting check passes at a difference >= 0 and does not decide the status.
